Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and adhere to quality and safety standards.

We are seeking a Technical Program Associate responsible for implementing and managing the technology used across our programs - including systems for recipient data collection, verification, payments, and monitoring. In this role, you will own all technology-related aspects of new project launches: working with our operations team to define and implement program requirements, project managing the implementation across multiple stakeholders, and analyzing, structuring, and acting on program data. You are a systems thinker who is comfortable assessing tradeoffs and deriving and communicating data-driven insights. You enjoy learning about technology in a variety of business contexts. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve. 3+ years of professional experience; we welcome a wide range of relevant backgrounds (e.g. project management, product management, data analytics, international development, management consulting). Strong data skills: able to leverage tools to extract, clean, manipulate, and analyze data to make operational decisions. Intermediate experience using a programming or scripting language (most commonly Python at GD) to automate workflows, validate data, or implement business logic. Note: This is not an engineering or data science job. Significant interest in technology, systems design and building. High attention to detail and strong instincts for analysis and validating data creatively and rigorously. Structured approach to problem-solving and a drive to uncover and fix root causes rather than surface-level issues. Ability to collaborate inclusively with stakeholders across varied social, national, and cultural backgrounds, including communicating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Fluency in English. Preferred, not required: Experience working with relational databases (e.g. SQL). Compensation At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably.
